title: Prospect Pipeline Board
details: The stage-wise prospect board now shows smarter columns, counts, progress, richer prospect cards, activity chips, source filters, and a real API refresh action.

title: Prospect List Workspace
details: The prospect list now includes KPI tiles, source and type filters, stage chips, better row content, contact previews, activity counts, website links, and double-click detail navigation.

title: Date-wise Visit Planner View
details: Date-wise visits now include summary tiles, date range search, status, type, employee filters, expandable day groups, visit cards, map actions, prospect links, and task links.

title: Role Permission Management
details: Admins can select a role, review module-wise feature permissions, toggle permissions locally, and save all changes in one bulk API request.

title: User Permission Management
details: The permission area now separates My Permissions and User Permission views, with grouped feature cards and update support for selected users.

title: Task Details Experience
details: Task details now present priority, type, status, progress, visit relation, files, activity, and controls in a more structured task workspace layout.

title: Task Calendar Upgrade
details: The calendar was improved to handle multiple tasks per day with clearer daily indicators, useful summaries, and better task visibility inside each date.

title: Prospect Detail Workspace
details: Prospect details now show relationship data, stage journey, contact people, notes, activity, meetings, email, tasks, and key profile information in a smarter layout.

title: Department View Refresh
details: The department page was redesigned with clearer department metrics, smarter cards, stronger scanning behavior, and cleaner actions for department-level work.

title: Advanced Sidebar Navigation
details: The sidebar now supports a cleaner grouped menu, active states, search, collapsible sections, profile summary, and smoother navigation interactions.
